تعازيت (form VI)
# تَعَازَيْتُ (taʕāzaytu) /ta.ʕaː.zaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَازَى (taʕāzā)
# تَعَازَيْتَ (taʕāzayta) /ta.ʕaː.zaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَازَى (taʕāzā)
# تَعَازَيْتِ (taʕāzayti) /ta.ʕaː.zaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَازَى (taʕāzā)
